newsitem.title: USA: Supervalu to buy back 13 pct of its shares.
newsitem.headline: Supervalu to buy back 13 pct of its shares.

text.p: Supervalu Inc said Wednesday its board has approved the repurchase of 8.5 million shares, or about 13 percent of its outstanding shares.
Supervalu said it expects fund the stock repurchase primarily with proceeds from the sale of the company's holdings in ShopKo Stores Inc.

In April, Supervalu said it planned to shed its 46 percent investment in ShopKo through two transactions. Supervalu first will sell 8,174,387 shares back to ShopKo for an aggregate of $150 million. It then will sell 6,557,280 shares in a secondary public offering.

The secondary offering, which is in registration, will be completed only if the share price is at or above $18.35, Supervalu said. As of the close of the market on June 10, ShopKo shares were priced at $25.875.
When the transactions were disclosed, Supervalu said proceeds from the sale of its ShopKo holdings could be used to purchase treasury stock, reduce debt or for other corporate purposes.
